```{r Enriched Heatmap}
# ---- Libraries ----
library(tidyverse)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)
library(EnrichedHeatmap)
library(ComplexHeatmap)

# ---- Setup lists ----
Species_Genes_gtf <- list()
Species_Transcripts_gtf <- list()
Species_Canonical_Mappings <- list()
Species_Canonical_Transcripts_gtf <- list()
MutationDensityPlots <- list()
MutationDensityData <- list()

# ---- Main loop ----
lapply(names(Reduced_Variants), function(element_name) {

  element <- Reduced_Variants[[element_name]]

  build <- str_split(element_name, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,5]
  species <- str_split(element_name, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,4] %>%
    str_replace("^(.)(.*)$", "\\1_\\2")

  # ---- Load GTF ----
  full.gtf <- rtracklayer::import(
    paste0("/home/ocdm0351/.conda/envs/snpEff/share/snpeff-5.2-2/data/",
           species, "/", build, "/genes.gtf"))

  genes.gtf <- subset(full.gtf, type == "gene")
  protein.coding.genes.gtf <- subset(genes.gtf, gene_biotype == "protein_coding")

  Species_Genes_gtf[[element_name]] <<- genes.gtf

  transcripts.gtf <- subset(full.gtf, type == "transcript")
  Species_Transcripts_gtf[[element_name]] <<- transcripts.gtf

  Species_Canonical_Mappings[[element_name]] <<- read_tsv(
    paste0("/home/ocdm0351/DPhil/R_Data/Canonical_Transcripts_",
           species, "_", build, "_snpEffSift.tsv"))

  canonical_transcripts.gtf <- subset(
    transcripts.gtf,
    transcript_id %in% Species_Canonical_Mappings[[element_name]]$transcriptId)

  Species_Canonical_Transcripts_gtf[[element_name]] <<- canonical_transcripts.gtf

  # ---- Variants → GRanges ----
  variant_ranges <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(
    element,
    keep.extra.columns = TRUE,
    ignore.strand = TRUE,
    seqnames.field = "CHROM",
    start.field = "POS",
    end.field = "POS"
  )

  variant_ranges <- coverage(variant_ranges)
  variant_ranges <- as(variant_ranges, "GRanges")
  variant_ranges <- variant_ranges[variant_ranges$score > 0]

  # ---- Parameters ----
  mean_mode_type <- "absolute"
  window <- 50
  extend_value <- 5000
  target_ratio_value <- 0.6

  # ---- Normalize ----
  body_variants <- normalizeToMatrix(
    variant_ranges,
    protein.coding.genes.gtf,
    extend = extend_value,
    mean_mode = mean_mode_type,
    w = window,
    target_ratio = target_ratio_value,
    smooth = TRUE,
    background = 0
  )

  # ---- Summarise ----
  avg <- colMeans(body_variants)
  se <- apply(body_variants, 2, function(x) sd(x)/sqrt(length(x)))

  MutationDensities <- data.frame(
    position = seq_along(avg),
    mean_score = avg,
    se = se,
    species = species,
    element_name = element_name
  )

  MutationDensityData[[element_name]] <<- MutationDensities

})

# ---- REMOVE human datasets BEFORE combining ----
MutationDensityData <- MutationDensityData[
  !grepl("Hsapiens", names(MutationDensityData))
]

# ---- Combine ----
Combined_MutationDensityData <- dplyr::bind_rows(MutationDensityData)

# ---- Normalize within species (enrichment) ----
Combined_MutationDensityData <- Combined_MutationDensityData %>%
  dplyr::group_by(species) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    mean_score = mean_score / mean(mean_score)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# ---- Define TSS / TTS in bins ----
target_ratio_value <- 0.6
extend_value <- 5000

n_bins <- max(Combined_MutationDensityData$position)

regionLength <- target_ratio_value * n_bins
lengthEachSide <- (n_bins - regionLength) / 2

tss_bin <- lengthEachSide
tts_bin <- n_bins - lengthEachSide

# ---- MULTI-SPECIES PLOT ----
MultiSpeciesPlot <-
  ggplot(Combined_MutationDensityData,
         aes(x = position,
             y = mean_score,
             color = species,
             fill = species)) +

  geom_line(size = 1.2) +

  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_score - se,
                  ymax = mean_score + se),
              alpha = 0.2,
              colour = NA) +

  # ---- Gene body shading ----
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = tss_bin, xmax = tts_bin,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           alpha = 0.05, fill = "grey") +

  # ---- TSS / TTS lines ----
  geom_vline(xintercept = tss_bin, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = tts_bin, linetype = "dashed") +

  # ---- Labels ----
  annotate("text", x = tss_bin,
           y = max(Combined_MutationDensityData$mean_score),
           label = "TSS", vjust = -0.5) +

  annotate("text", x = tts_bin,
           y = max(Combined_MutationDensityData$mean_score),
           label = "TTS", vjust = -0.5) +

  # ---- Axis relabel ----
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(1, tss_bin, tts_bin, n_bins),
    labels = c(paste0("-", extend_value),
               "TSS",
               "TTS",
               paste0("+", extend_value))
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Position relative to gene",
    y = "Relative Mutation Enrichment",
    title = "Mutation Enrichment Across Gene Bodies (Non-human species)"
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# ---- Save ----
ggsave(
  filename = "/home/ocdm0351/DPhil/R_Data/Plots/2_GeneBody_Plots/MultiSpecies_Metagene_Enrichment_NoHuman.png",
  plot = MultiSpeciesPlot,
  width = 25,
  height = 15,
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 1000,
  bg = "transparent"
)
```
